changes: Verified-only search narrows the index before candidate loading only when every indexed tier tag matches the stored approval.
Missing, conflicting or unsupported tier projections keep the original authorization path. Every candidate still passes provisioning authorization.
The disk projection check is cached and serialized within each index. It uses existing record data and requires no index format change.
Relevance ordering is unchanged; the private wider-pool experiment was not deployed.
limits: Checks cover the recorded public browser and diagnostic-account paths, not all customer tasks or all harness runtimes.
The large API publication remains held by its retrieval comparison and must be rebased on the current segmented catalogue before reconsideration.
No newsletter, brand, domain, DNS, account, paid charge or Cloudflare production migration was introduced.
